unit_conversion.note: E_SI/sqrt(P_SI) = E_meep/sqrt(F_meep) * sqrt(1/(eps0 c a^2)) = *sqrt(Z0/a^2); U_SI/P_SI = (U/F)_meep * a/c.

stored_energy_per_ref.note: U_cmt = A P_in Q_i/omega0 (clean design point). Field routes are the measured, band-tail-diluted N=3 build-up; U_field << U_cmt is the documented Fano dilution and does NOT enter Q_J.

q_j.formula: Q_J = Rn eps0 eps_c omega0 V_mode / d_eff^2

requirement.criterion: Q_rad, Q_mat >= 10 Q_J  (>= ~90% of intrinsic loss to junction)
requirement.verdict: The default d_eff = 100 nm (bare vdW stack) is NOT in range: Q_J = 1.26e+08 >> 2700, so the junction is a negligible loss channel (only 0.0141% of the intrinsic dissipation reaches it). Meeting Q_rad,Q_mat >= 10 Q_J needs d_eff >= ~21.6 um -- i.e. engineered antenna/electrode coupling, not the bare stack.

absolute_voltage_thread.note: At the v0.3 reference P_in = 90 nW the measured (diluted) cavity field puts only ~1.04 uV across a 100 nm junction vs the 0.6 mV the drive design requires -- consistent with the Q_J closure: the bare stack is far too short.

cmt_cross_check.dilution_justification: band-tail/Fano: measured on-resonance absorbed fraction ~5.8% (TCMT fit R^2~0.45) vs a clean on-band resonance; the field build-up and hence the stored energy are diluted by ~1-2x10^1.
cmt_cross_check.tight_20pct_check: independent band-power vs flux S21 TCMT fits (brief AT-3 consistency)

provenance.auto_fill_note: Q_J closure is N_rows-independent (uses V_mode, not per-N Q_w); it re-reads photonics.json every run, so the pending N2/N4 in-situ ring-downs auto-propagate idempotently when photonics.json fills them in.

integration_json_update.note: delivered here (out/qj_closure.json) so integration.json is updated WITHOUT editing run_integration.py (unowned); main() also merges this block into integration.json under the namespaced key 'qj_closure'.

qj_closure.Q_J_formula: Q_J = Rn eps0 eps_c omega0 V_mode / d_eff^2
